Reliance Foundation Announces Rs 100 Crore Scholarship for 5,100 Students

Reliance Foundation has opened applications for its scholarship program, aiming to support 5,100 first-year undergraduate and postgraduate students. The initiative is valued at Rs 100 crore and is described as "all-inclusive." The scholarships are intended to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education.
